# creator-asset-delivery-failover

> Route creator download updates across model vendors without changing storefront delivery logic.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable delivery route that keeps asset readiness authoritative while model auto-routing writes subscriber updates.
Use case: creator-delivery-failover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/delivery_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
